research_result.description: Airtable is a cloud-based database and spreadsheet platform that provides a Web API and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for querying, creating, and updating records, bases, schemas, and automations.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can create Personal Access Tokens (PATs) directly from the developer hub or register OAuth 2.0 integrations to request authorization from end users. Free self-serve accounts provide API access with rate limits, while higher plans offer unlimited calls and enterprise features.

evidence.claim: Airtable Web API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON, and uses standard HTTP codes.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON to encode objects, and relies on standard HTTP codes to signal operation outcomes.

evidence.claim: Airtable supports personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens for API authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.

evidence.claim: Requests are authenticated using HTTP authorization bearer token headers.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Airtable's API uses token-based authentication, allowing users to authenticate API requests by inputting their tokens into the HTTP authorization bearer token header.

evidence.claim: Airtable provides an official MCP server to connect AI tools directly to Airtable bases.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Airtable’s MCP server lets you connect AI tools directly to your Airtable bases.

evidence.claim: Airtable provides a Free plan with access to Base Data endpoints.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Access to all "Base Data" endpoints except "Views"
